name: Annualized CME Futures Basis — BTC vs ETH
description: Research study comparing the annualized basis between spot crypto prices (BTC/USD, ETH/USD) and their corresponding front-month CME futures contracts (BT, ER). Basis is calculated as ((Futures / Spot) - 1) * (365 / DTE) * 100, using NoAdjustment continuation to preserve actual price levels. Outputs a cross-sectional line chart of basis over time and a summary table with current, average, max, and min basis per asset.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ANNUALIZED CME FUTURES BASIS — BTC vs ETH
# =============================================================================
#
# Compares spot crypto (BTCUSD, ETHUSD) vs CME front-month futures (BT, ER).
# Basis formula: ((Futures / Spot) - 1) * (365 / DTE) * 100
#
# Uses NoAdjustment to preserve actual futures price levels for basis math.
# DTE (days to expiry) comes from futures_continuation output.
# =============================================================================

# --- Futures data (primary: BT-Futures or ER-Futures per asset) ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

futures_close = cont.c
dte = cont.dte

# --- Spot crypto reference data ---
btc_spot_data = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.BTCUSD)()
eth_spot_data = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.ETHUSD)()
btc_spot = btc_spot_data.c
eth_spot = eth_spot_data.c

# --- Map each futures asset to its corresponding spot price ---
is_btc = is_asset_ref(ticker="BT")()
is_eth = is_asset_ref(ticker="ER")()
spot = conditional_select(is_btc, btc_spot, is_eth, eth_spot, 0)

# --- Annualized basis (%) ---
# ((Futures / Spot) - 1) * (365 / DTE) * 100
# Guard against DTE = 0 (shouldn't happen, but be safe)
raw_basis = ((futures_close / spot) - 1.0) * (365.0 / dte) * 100.0
ann_basis = where(dte > 0, raw_basis)

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Cross-sectional line chart — basis over time for BTC and ETH
# =============================================================================
cs_lines(
    title='Annualized CME Futures Basis — BTC vs ETH',
    category='Basis Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Basis (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ann_basis,))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Summary table — per-asset basis statistics
# =============================================================================
# --- Compute summary stats for the table ---
avg_basis = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(ann_basis)
max_basis = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(ann_basis)
min_basis = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(ann_basis)

cs_summary_table(
    title='Basis Statistics',
    category='Basis Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Basis (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Basis (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max Basis (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min Basis (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(ann_basis, avg_basis, max_basis, min_basis)
